# The Q Journal

> A men's grooming journal at https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/: practical advice on haircuts, beards, skin and styling, seasonal guides, and editorial product picks. Articles are published under the "The Q Journal" byline.

## Key facts
- Name: The Q Journal
- Type: men's grooming journal (editorial site)
- Byline: The Q Journal
- Website: https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/
- Journal index: https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/blog
- RSS: https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/feed.xml
- Editorial contact: info@theqsalonsrq.com
- Product picks: 17 grooming products linked to Amazon. Disclosure: "As an Amazon Associate, The Q Salon earns from qualifying purchases."

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/): Men's grooming, explained: which haircut suits your face, fade vs taper, pomade vs clay, beard care and the products worth buying. Practical guides from The Q Journal.
- [Journal](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/blog): Every guide from The Q Journal: men's haircuts by face shape, fades and tapers, hair products, beard care, thinning hair and seasonal gift guides.
- [Grooming guide](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/grooming-guide): Practical men's grooming tips from The Q Journal: fades, styling products, gray blending, razor bumps and beard care in Florida humidity.
- [Product picks](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/shop): The Q Journal's picks for the best men's grooming products: pomade, clay, styling powder, beard oil and balm, scalp care, SPF moisturizer, fragrance and trimmers.
- [About](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/about): About The Q Journal: what the men's grooming journal covers, how product picks are chosen and how affiliate links are disclosed.
- [Most attractive haircuts](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/what-haircut-do-girls-like): The most attractive haircuts for men, and why they work: the textured crop, the classic side part, the low taper and more. What women notice first, and how to ask for it.
- [The 3-2-1 rule](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/3-2-1-rule-mens-haircuts): What the 3-2-1 haircut rule means: a #3 guard on top, #2 on the sides and #1 at the edges, plus the proportion version barbers use. Lengths, how to ask for it and who it suits.
- [What haircut should I get](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/what-haircut-should-i-get): Not sure what haircut to get? Match it to your face shape (oval, round, square, long, heart) and your hair type, then use our checklist for asking your barber.
- [Fade vs taper](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/fade-vs-taper-which-is-better): Fade vs taper haircut: what's the difference, low vs mid vs high, skin fades and the low taper fade, how each grows out, and exactly what to say to your barber.
- [Hair systems guide](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/toupee-hair-system-guide): A straight guide to men's hair systems and toupees: base types (lace, skin, mono), how they're attached, upkeep, how long they last, and the alternatives to consider first.
- [Receding hairline haircuts](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/haircuts-for-receding-hairline): The best men's haircuts for a receding hairline: the buzz cut, crew cut, textured crop and short fade, plus the styles that make thinning more obvious and the products that help.
- [Pomade vs clay vs gel](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/pomade-vs-clay-vs-gel): Pomade, clay, gel or styling powder? How each men's hair product holds, how it finishes, which haircuts it suits, and what holds up best in Florida humidity.
- [Beard oil vs balm](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/beard-oil-vs-beard-balm): Beard oil or beard balm? What each one does, which beard length needs which, how to use them together, and what works in hot, humid weather.
- [Gift guide](https://www.theqsalonsrq.com/mens-grooming-gift-guide): Holiday grooming gifts for men from The Q Journal: beard oil, pomade, clay, styling powder, an SPF moisturizer and a body trimmer, sorted by the kind of guy you're shopping for.
